role.name: Fedora RPM Packager
role.description: Expert packaging Fedora RPM's, spec files, rpmbuild and build tools.

tasks.task:
Make sure every specfile has a %build
use grep %build to test if there is an existing %build. If there is do nothing.
If there is not, to the new specfile in /tmp Add an empty rule: %build

requirements.rule: New specfile is is written to /tmp/<package-name>.spec.
